invariants.rationale: Method always assigns a HoodieWriteMetadata instance to 'result' before returning, never returns null.
Both branches set write statuses before returning, never leaving it null.
Config is used to call methods unconditionally, so it cannot be null at exit.
Table is dereferenced for multiple method calls, so cannot be null at return.
deleteExecutor is called in both branches, so must be non-null.
